cash.title: Cash management
cash.description: Track deposits, withdrawals, multi-currency balances and Forex conversions alongside your investments.
cash.movementsDescription: Every cash movement in this portfolio: manual operations and movements derived from transactions.

enable.title: Cash tracking is off for this portfolio
enable.description: Your current workflow stays unchanged: purchases never require a deposit. Enable cash tracking to record deposits, withdrawals, balances and conversions with precision.

resume.title: Cash tracking is paused
resume.description: Your cash history was kept when tracking was disabled. Resume with the existing history, or start over to delete it and rebuild from scratch.
resume.wipeMessage: All cash movements of this portfolio will be permanently deleted, including deposits, withdrawals and adjustments you entered manually. Your asset transactions are not affected. You can then set up cash tracking again from scratch.

table.derivedHint: Generated from a transaction — edit the transaction instead
table.estimatedHint: Reconstructed by Portfolium as the minimum funding your transactions required — not a verified deposit. Edit it to confirm or correct it.

movementModal.title: New cash movement
movementModal.amountHelp: Always positive, the operation type sets the sign.

activation.title: Enable cash tracking
activation.stepConfigure: Step 1 of 2 — Choose how your cash history starts.
activation.stepReview: Step 2 of 2 — Review what will happen, then confirm.
activation.replayDescription: Portfolium scans your entire transaction history automatically and rebuilds every cash movement — nothing to configure.
activation.openingsDescription: Cash begins on a date you choose, with balances you enter. Earlier transactions never affect cash.
activation.warnDescription: Operations always go through; you are warned when a balance would go negative.
activation.strictDescription: Anything that would overdraw a balance is rejected, with the exact missing amount.
activation.nothingWritten: Nothing is written yet — the next step shows a preview you can still cancel.
activation.reviewReplaySummary: Your transactions were scanned back to {{date}}. Enabling tracking will create {{count}} cash movements from them.
activation.reviewOpeningsSummary: Cash will start on {{date}} with the balances you entered. {{count}} cash movements will be derived from transactions after that date.
activation.inferredIntro: Estimated deposits will be added on the days your recorded transactions needed funding:
activation.inferredNote: Estimates assume you contributed only the minimum needed, exactly when needed. They are labeled as estimated in your movement list and you can edit or replace them at any time.

settings.title: Cash tracking settings
settings.description: Warning mode allows negative balances and warns you; strict mode rejects operations that lack cash.
settings.disableHint: Disabling keeps your cash history; it is simply excluded from valuation. Deleting the ledger is a separate, explicit action.

warnings.projectedNegative: This operation makes the {{currency}} balance negative.
warnings.strictWillReject: Strict mode: this operation will be rejected — insufficient {{currency}} cash.

fx.partialRates: Some balances could not be converted: their exchange rate is unavailable. They are excluded from the converted total (never assumed 1:1).
fx.staleRates: Some exchange rates are stale (older than 4 hours). Values will refresh when rates are available again.
fx.pnlDeferred: FX P&L will arrive in a future release

empty.balancesDescription: Record a deposit to start tracking cash.

toasts.ledgerWiped: Cash history deleted — you can set up tracking again

errors.generic: The operation failed. Please try again.
errors.sameCurrency: Source and target currencies must differ.
errors.deleteWouldStrand: Deleting this movement would make the {{currency}} balance negative at a later date.
errors.strictNeedsNonNegative: Strict mode requires the whole cash history to stay non-negative. Fix the negative balances first.
errors.ledgerStale: Transactions changed while tracking was off; the retained cash history no longer matches. Wipe the ledger and re-enable tracking.
errors.strictActivationDip: Strict mode needs {{missing}} more {{currency}} on {{date}}. Increase the opening balance or choose warning mode.

cash.deleteMovementMessage: The movement will be removed from the ledger. In strict mode the deletion is rejected if later spending would no longer be covered.
cash.deleteConversionMessage: Both legs of the conversion (and its fee) will be removed together.
